author: heroNoel
body:
Hello, sry for my bad english because I'm a german guy :D
At first I would like to explain you why I'm banned.
The PC from my Brother was "Kapput" or broken.
He has used my PC but with my Profile too. And he have hacks -.-
He was banned with my account.
I hope i can unbanned because, it wasn't me who hacked.
I'm sry for this.
LG Noel
